message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Details | |-------|------------|---------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001–545.004 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Children under 5 must be in a rear‑facing seat. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for adults.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021, 545.022 | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• “Yield” signs give priority to the vehicle already in the intersection. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021–545.023 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• No passing on either side of a stopped bus with flashing red lights. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other vehicles.
• Keep a safe following distance. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant.
• No parking in front of a driveway or on a sidewalk.
• Parking in a handicap space requires a valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered annually.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021–545.023 | | **Toll Roads & Bridges** | • Texas has several toll roads (e.g., Sam Houston Tollway).
• Electronic toll collection (TxTag) is required for some routes. | TxDOT website | | **Emergency Vehicle Rules** | • Drivers must pull over to the right and stop when an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Miscellaneous** | • No “hand‑held” texting or calling.
• No “hands‑free” texting while driving.
• No “hands‑free” calling while driving. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | ### How to Stay Updated - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official rules, updates, and driver’s handbook. - **Texas Transportation Code** – Statutory law; available online via the Texas Legislature’s website. - **Texas Driver Handbook** – Practical guide for new drivers and refresher courses. --- #### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re set for safety. 2. **Keep your seat belt fastened** – it’s a legal requirement and saves lives. 3. **Avoid distractions** – cell‑phones, eating, or adjusting mirrors while driving. 4. **Respect school buses and pedestrians** – they have priority. 5. **Check your vehicle’s registration and inspection status** before hitting the road. Feel free to ask if you need deeper details on any specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
